summary.text: Melissa Murray is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 24 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Murray took office on January 1, 2019, succeeding Marc Cote.
For 2023-2024 she was vice chair of the Senate Finance Committee and also served on the Senate Labor Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
